verdict: Leads arriving at a strong cost; one tracking gap is being fixed.
narrative: Over the last 28 days, you received 22 leads from Meta at a cost of $11.68 per lead on $256.99 in total spend — efficient and holding steady against your prior active periods. The most recent 3-day window (Oct 27–29) averaged 2.3 leads per day compared to 3.7 in the 3 days before, a soft deceleration we're watching closely heading into next week. Pipeline tracking is temporarily unavailable due to an authentication issue, so we cannot confirm how those leads are converting downstream — that connection is being restored now. On the local search side, your Google Business profiles drove 194 total actions and 18 calls this period; two of the three profiles are underperforming on call rate and we're working to bring them in line with the stronger third profile.
